// src/actors/neural_actor.pony
// Pony Neural Actor for JAIDE V35: High-performance actor for distributed neural computations.

use "collections"
use "net"
use "time"
use "serialise"
use "tensor"
use "promises"
use "debug"
use "wallclock"

primitive _SerialId
  fun hash(): U64 => 0xA1B2C3D4E5F67890

type _SerialId is (None | U64)

actor NeuralActor is Serialise
  let _env: Env
  let _id: String
  let _behavior: (NeuralActor tag, Message tag) => None
  let _tasks: List[Task tag]
  let _metrics: Metrics
  let _scheduler: (Scheduler tag | None)
  let _peers: List[Peer tag]
  let _state: State

  new create(env: Env, id: String, config: Config tag) =>
    _env = env
    _id = id
    _behavior = _default_behavior
    _tasks = _tasks.create()
    _metrics = Metrics.create()
    _scheduler = None
    _peers = _peers.create()
    _state = State.create(config)

  be serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32(_SerialId.hash().u32())
    writer.string(_id)

  be deserialise(reader: Reader) =>
    _id = reader.string()

  be set_behavior(behavior: (NeuralActor tag, Message tag) => None) =>
    _behavior = behavior

  be add_peer(peer: Peer tag) =>
    try
      _peers.push(peer)
    else
      _env.out.print("Failed to add peer")
    end

  be remove_peer(peer: Peer tag) =>
    try
      _peers.delete_eq(peer)
    else
      _env.out.print("Peer not found")
    end

  be submit_task(task: Task tag) =>
    try
      _tasks.push(task)
      _dispatch_task()
    else
      task.promise.reject("Task queue full")
    end

  be _dispatch_task() =>
    try
      let task = _tasks.shift()?
      _execute_task(task)
    else
      // No tasks
      None
    end

  be _execute_task(task: Task tag) =>
    let start = WallClock.now()
    try
      match task.op
      | let op: TensorOp tag =>
        let result = _compute_tensor(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      | let op: QuantumOp tag =>
        let result = _simulate_quantum(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      | let op: SSMStep tag =>
        let result = _ssm_forward(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      | let op: KANLayer tag =>
        let result = _kan_forward(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      | let op: TGNUpdate tag =>
        let result = _tgn_update(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      else
        task.promise.reject("Unknown operation")
      end
      let duration = WallClock.now() - start
      _metrics.record_completion(duration)
    else
      task.promise.reject("Execution failed")
    end

  fun _compute_tensor(op: TensorOp tag): Tensor tag =>
    match op.kind
    | "matmul" =>
      let a = recover val op.a end
      let b = recover val op.b end
      Tensor.matmul(a, b)
    | "conv" =>
      let input = recover val op.input end
      let kernel = recover val op.kernel end
      Tensor.conv2d(input, kernel, op.padding, op.stride)
    | "relu" =>
      let x = recover val op.x end
      Tensor.relu(x)
    | "softmax" =>
      let x = recover val op.x end
      Tensor.softmax(x, op.axis)
    | "layer_norm" =>
      let x = recover val op.x end
      let gamma = recover val op.gamma end
      let beta = recover val op.beta end
      Tensor.layer_norm(x, gamma, beta, op.eps)
    else
      recover val Tensor.zero(op.shape) end
    end

  fun _simulate_quantum(op: QuantumOp tag): (QuantumState tag | Float) =>
    let state = recover val op.state end
    match op.gate
    | "hadamard" =>
      state.apply_hadamard(op.qubit)
      state
    | "cnot" =>
      state.apply_cnot(op.control, op.target)
      state
    | "rx" =>
      state.apply_rx(op.qubit, op.angle)
      state
    | "measure" =>
      let shots = if op.shots > 0 then op.shots else 1
      state.simulate_shots(shots)
    | "bell" =>
      state.bell_state()
    | "ghz" =>
      state.ghz_state(op.num_qubits)
    | "fidelity" =>
      let other = recover val op.other end
      state.fidelity(other)
    | "entanglement_entropy" =>
      state.entanglement_entropy(op.partition)
    else
      state
    end

  fun _ssm_forward(op: SSMStep tag): Tensor tag =>
    let state = recover val op.state end
    let input = recover val op.input end
    let A = recover val op.A end
    let B = recover val op.B end
    let C = recover val op.C end
    let dt = op.dt
    let new_state = SSM.s4d_update(dt, A, B, C, state)
    let output = Tensor.mul(C, new_state.h)
    output

  fun _kan_forward(op: KANLayer tag): Tensor tag =>
    let input = recover val op.input end
    let coeffs = recover val op.coeffs end
    let knots = recover val op.knots end
    let degree = op.degree
    KAN.eval_spline(input, coeffs, knots, degree)

  fun _tgn_update(op: TGNUpdate tag): Tensor tag =>
    let nodes = recover val op.nodes end
    let edges = recover val op.edges end
    let time_delta = op.time_delta
    TGN.message_pass(nodes, edges, time_delta)

  be broadcast_state() =>
    let msg = Message.state_update(_state)
    for peer in _peers.values() do
      peer.receive(msg)
    end

  be receive(msg: Message tag) =>
    _behavior(this, msg)

  fun _default_behavior(actor: NeuralActor tag, msg: Message tag) =>
    match msg
    | let m: StateUpdate tag =>
      _state.update(m.delta)
      actor.broadcast_state()
    | let m: MetricsRequest tag =>
      m.promise.resolve(_metrics.summary())
    | let m: Shutdown tag =>
      actor._shutdown()
    else
      None
    end

  be _shutdown() =>
    for task in _tasks.values() do
      task.promise.reject("Actor shutting down")
    end
    _env.out.printv("NeuralActor " + _id + " shutdown")

  be metrics_request(promise: Promise[MetricsSummary] tag) =>
    promise.resolve(_metrics.summary())

class Config is Serialise
  let dim: USize = 18432
  let layers: USize = 768
  let seq_len: USize = 128000
  let sparsity: F64 = 0.05

  new create() => None

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("Config".u32())
    writer.usize(dim)
    writer.usize(layers)
    writer.usize(seq_len)
    writer.f64(sparsity)

class State is Serialise
  let config: Config
  var weights: Tensor
  var optimizer_state: OptimizerState

  new create(config': Config tag) =>
    config = config'
    weights = Tensor.random(config.dim, config.dim, NormalDist(0.0, 0.02))
    optimizer_state = OptimizerState.create()

  be update(delta: Tensor tag) =>
    weights = weights + delta * 0.001  // Simplified update

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("State".u32())
    config.serialise(writer)
    weights.serialise(writer)
    optimizer_state.serialise(writer)

class OptimizerState is Serialise
  var lr: F64 = 0.0001
  var betas: (F64, F64) = (0.9, 0.999)
  var step: USize = 0

  new create() => None

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("OptimizerState".u32())
    writer.f64(lr)
    writer.f64(betas._1)
    writer.f64(betas._2)
    writer.usize(step)

class Metrics
  var total_tasks: USize = 0
  var total_time: F64 = 0.0
  var avg_time: F64 = 0.0

  new create() => None

  be record_completion(duration: I64) =>
    total_tasks = total_tasks + 1
    total_time = total_time + duration.f64()
    avg_time = total_time / total_tasks.f64()

  fun summary(): MetricsSummary =>
    MetricsSummary(total_tasks, avg_time)

class MetricsSummary
  let tasks: USize
  let avg: F64

  new create(tasks': USize, avg': F64) =>
    tasks = tasks'
    avg = avg'

trait tag Message is Serialise
  fun string(): String

class iso StateUpdate is Message
  let delta: Tensor tag

  new iso create(delta': Tensor tag) =>
    delta = consume delta'

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("StateUpdate".u32())
    delta.serialise(writer)

  fun string() => "StateUpdate"

class iso MetricsRequest is Message
  let promise: Promise[MetricsSummary] tag

  new iso create(promise': Promise[MetricsSummary] tag) =>
    promise = consume promise'

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) => writer.u32("MetricsRequest".u32())

  fun string() => "MetricsRequest"

class iso Shutdown is Message
  fun serialise(writer: Writer) => writer.u32("Shutdown".u32())
  fun string() => "Shutdown"

class iso TensorOp is Message
  let kind: String
  let a: Tensor box
  let b: Tensor box
  let shape: (USize, USize)
  let padding: USize
  let stride: USize
  let axis: USize
  let eps: F64
  let gamma: Tensor box
  let beta: Tensor box
  let input: Tensor box
  let kernel: Tensor box
  let x: Tensor box

  new create(kind': String, a': (Tensor box | None), b': (Tensor box | None), shape': (USize, USize)) =>
    kind = kind'
    a = a' or Tensor.zero(1,1)
    b = b' or Tensor.zero(1,1)
    shape = shape'
    padding = 0
    stride = 1
    axis = 0
    eps = 1e-5
    gamma = Tensor.ones(1)
    beta = Tensor.zeros(1)
    input = Tensor.zeros(1,1,1,1)
    kernel = Tensor.ones(1,1,1,1)
    x = Tensor.zeros(1)

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("TensorOp".u32())
    writer.string(kind)
    a.serialise(writer)
    b.serialise(writer)

  fun string() => "TensorOp(" + kind + ")"

class iso QuantumOp is Message
  let gate: String
  let qubit: USize
  let control: USize
  let target: USize
  let angle: F64
  let state: QuantumState box
  let other: QuantumState box
  let partition: USize
  let shots: USize
  let num_qubits: USize

  new create(gate': String, qubit': USize, state': QuantumState box) =>
    gate = gate'
    qubit = qubit'
    control = 0
    target = 0
    angle = 0.0
    state = state'
    other = QuantumState.zero(1)
    partition = 1
    shots = 1024
    num_qubits = 1

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("QuantumOp".u32())
    writer.string(gate)
    writer.usize(qubit)

  fun string() => "QuantumOp(" + gate + ")"

class iso SSMStep is Message
  let state: SSMState box
  let input: Tensor box
  let A: Tensor box
  let B: Tensor box
  let C: Tensor box
  let dt: F64

  new create(state': SSMState box, input': Tensor box) =>
    state = state'
    input = input'
    A = Tensor.eye(64)
    B = Tensor.ones(1,64)
    C = Tensor.ones(64,1)
    dt = 0.01

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("SSMStep".u32())

  fun string() => "SSMStep"

class iso KANLayer is Message
  let input: Tensor box
  let coeffs: Tensor box
  let knots: Tensor box
  let degree: USize

  new create(input': Tensor box) =>
    input = input'
    coeffs = Tensor.random(7,18432, NormalDist(0.0,0.1))
    knots = Tensor.linspace(0.0,1.0,10)
    degree = 3

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("KANLayer".u32())

  fun string() => "KANLayer"

class iso TGNUpdate is Message
  let nodes: Tensor box
  let edges: Tensor box
  let time_delta: Vector[F64] box

  new create(nodes': Tensor box) =>
    nodes = nodes'
    edges = Tensor.random(32768,32768, UniformDist(0.0,1.0))
    time_delta = Vector.from_array([1.0,2.0,3.0])

  fun serialise(writer: Writer) =>
    writer.u32("TGNUpdate".u32())

  fun string() => "TGNUpdate"

class Task
  let op: (Message tag | None)
  let promise: Promise[Any tag]

  new create(op': Message tag, promise': Promise[Any tag]) =>
    op = op'
    promise = promise'

class Promise[A: Any tag]
  let _fulfill: (A !) => None
  let _reject: (String !) => None

  new create(fulfill': (A !) => None, reject': (String !) => None) =>
    _fulfill = fulfill'
    _reject = reject'

  be resolve(value: box->A !) =>
    _fulfill(value)

  be reject(reason: String) =>
    _reject(reason)

type Any is (None | Bool | I64 | F64 | String | Tensor | QuantumState | SSMState | Vector[F64] | MetricsSummary)

class Vector[T: Equatable #share]
  let _data: Array[T] box

  new create() =>
    _data = Array[T]

  fun size(): USize => _data.size()

  be push(value: box->T) => _data.push(value)

  fun apply(i: USize): (T | None) ? => try _data(i)? else error end

class SSMState
  let h: Tensor

  new create(d: USize = 64) =>
    h = Tensor.zeros(d)

class Scheduler is TimerNotify
  let _owner: (NeuralActor tag | None)
  let _timers: List[Timer tag]

  new create(owner': NeuralActor tag) =>
    _owner = owner'
    _timers = _timers.create()

  fun _notify(timer: Timer tag, abstime: I64): Bool =>
    match timer
    | let t: DispatchTimer =>
      _owner.submit_task(t.task)
      true
    else
      true
    end

class DispatchTimer is TimerSpec
  let task: Task tag
  let period: I64

  new create(task': Task tag, period': I64) =>
    task = task'
    period = period'

  fun when(): TimerWhen => TimerWhen.scheduled()
  fun repeat(): Bool => true

class Peer
  let _conn: TCPConnection
  let _actor: NeuralActor tag

  new create(conn: TCPConnection tag, actor': NeuralActor tag) =>
    _conn = conn
    _actor = actor'
    _conn.set_notify(_notifier)

  be _notifier(event: AsioEvent, _, err: (AsioError | None)): None =>
    match event
    | AsioEvent.notify_read =>
      _receive()
    | AsioEvent.notify_closed =>
      _close()
    else
      None
    end

  be _receive() =>
    let data = recover val _conn.recv(1024) end
    let msg = Serialise.decode(data) as Message tag
    _actor.receive(msg)

  be _close() =>
    _conn.dispose()

actor Main
  new create(env: Env) =>
    let config = Config
    let actor = NeuralActor(env, "main", config)
    let task = Task(TensorOp("matmul", Tensor.eye(100), Tensor.random(100,100), (100,100)), Promise(_resolve, _reject))
    actor.submit_task(task)

  fun _resolve(result: Tensor tag) => None
  fun _reject(reason: String) => None

// End of neural_actor.pony
